When you arrive at the hospital by ambulance, you will be assessed by medical staff upon arrival. However, being brought in by ambulance does not automatically mean you will be seen immediately or have the highest priority. Instead, you will be triaged (assessed) and seen based on the urgency of your condition compared to other patients. If your condition is life-threatening, you will be seen right away; if not, you may have to wait.

Answer: A
